- public final class SearchService
  - Imports: direct imports for java.util.List and java.util.ArrayList.
  - Methods:
    - public List<User> search(List<User> users, String query)
      - If users == null: returns new empty ArrayList<>.
      - If query is null or blank after trimming: returns a defensive copy of users (never returns the original list object; if users is non-null, copy preserves order; if users is null, previous rule applies).
      - Otherwise: let q = lower-case trimmed query; for each non-null User in users, split user.getName() (null-safe treat as empty) on whitespace; include the user if any token lower-cased equals q. Preserves input order. Never mutates input list or user objects.
  - Semantics: Exact case-insensitive whitespace-delimited name token matching; the fixture ["Alice Smith", "Bob Jones"] queried with "smith" returns only Alice Smith.

- public interface UserRepository

- public final class InMemoryUserRepository implements UserRepository

  - Fields:
    - private final LinkedHashMap<String, User> store = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    - private final UserValidator validator = new UserValidator();
  - Constructor: public InMemoryUserRepository()
  - Methods:
    - public User findById(String id): returns store.get(id) or null.
    - public List<User> findAll(): returns new ArrayList<>(store.values()), preserving insertion/upsert order.
    - public User save(User user): if validator.isValid(user) is false, throws IllegalArgumentException; else store.put(user.getId(), user) and return the stored value.

  - Semantics: Deterministic upsert by id; defensive list returns; never exposes internal storage; does not perform any implicit logging.
